    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "file": "valid.c",
      "function": "xmlValidateElement",
      "line": 6094,
      "var": "value",
      "code": "value = xmlNodeListGetString(doc, attr->children, 0);",
      "role": "intermediate",
      "note": "DTD element validation serializes input-controlled attribute children with inLine set to 0, propagating the escaping mode toward xmlEscapeText."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "file": "tree.c",
      "function": "xmlNodeListGetStringInternal",
      "line": 1478,
      "var": "node->content",
      "code": "encoded = xmlEscapeText(node->content, flags);",
      "role": "intermediate",
      "note": "The input-controlled text node content and XML_ESCAPE_NON_ASCII flag are passed directly to xmlEscapeText."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "file": "xmlIO.c",
      "function": "xmlEscapeText",
      "line": 332,
      "var": "repl",
      "code": "repl = tempBuf;",
      "role": "root_cause",
      "note": "For a non-ASCII character, repl is made to point to the stack array tempBuf whose lifetime ends at the close of this block."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "file": "xmlIO.c",
      "function": "xmlEscapeText",
      "line": 362,
      "var": "repl",
      "code": "memcpy(out, repl, replSize);",
      "role": "sink",
      "note": "After tempBuf has gone out of scope, memcpy reads replSize bytes through the stale repl pointer, triggering stack-use-after-scope."
    }
  ],
  "vuln_logic": {
    "source": {
      "file": "tree.c",
      "function": "xmlNodeListGetString",
      "line": 1540,
      "operands": ["flags", "XML_ESCAPE_NON_ASCII"]
    },
    "root_cause": {
      "file": "xmlIO.c",
      "function": "xmlEscapeText",
      "line": 332,
      "operands": ["repl", "tempBuf"],
      "relation": {"op": "same_object", "left": "repl", "right": "tempBuf"}
    },
    "sink": {
      "file": "xmlIO.c",
      "function": "xmlEscapeText",
      "line": 362,
      "operands": ["repl", "replSize"],
      "relation": {"op": "gt", "left": "replSize", "right": "0"}
    },
    "propagation": [
      {
        "from": {"file": "tree.c", "function": "xmlNodeListGetString", "line": 1540, "operands": ["flags", "XML_ESCAPE_NON_ASCII"]},
        "to": {"file": "tree.c", "function": "xmlNodeListGetStringInternal", "line": 1478, "operands": ["node->content", "flags"]},
        "type": "data",
        "via": ["xmlNodeListGetStringInternal(list, escape, flags)"]
      },
      {
        "from": {"file": "tree.c", "function": "xmlNodeListGetStringInternal", "line": 1478, "operands": ["node->content", "flags"]},
        "to": {"file": "xmlIO.c", "function": "xmlEscapeText", "line": 362, "operands": ["repl", "replSize"]},
        "type": "data",
        "via": ["xmlEscapeText(node->content, flags)", "repl", "replSize"]
      }
    ]
  }
}
Path('/workspace/analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(analysis, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print('/workspace/poc.bin', len(data))
